evidence: Consolidated conditional return accounts on pinned engineering, market and financing paths. New owner-saving release and socioeconomic valuation assumptions do not establish contracts, market demand, actual inflation or a global welfare total.
boundary: U is the general economic unit and possible single currency or basket of U-related currencies serving the planned off-Earth economic zone before the Open Moon, planetary array and subsequent outer Solar System buildout.
reading_rule: Sponsor return is not global welfare. Interest relief is a transfer with an explicit external-saving release rule. Terminal book claims and dated liquidity episodes are separate. Economic purchase-price proxies omit unmeasured surplus and externalities; failed paths receive no future extrapolation.
